desc:
⚽🚗 Turbo Swipe is fast, physics-based car soccer. Boost, flip, and smash the ball into the net!

🎮 PLAY YOUR WAY
• Casual: jump into 1v1, 2v2, or 3v3 and pick all the sizes you want. The first match that forms takes you.
• Competitive: climb the 21-rank ladder, earn your emblem, and chase your best rank.
• Practice against bots whenever you want to warm up.

👥 Queue with friends and play as a party.

🏎️ Make it yours with cars, balls, and looks from the shop.

Updates are coming often, so follow the game and tell us what you want next!
